transport.pairing: existing same-SEQ context then command, task/action ownership unchanged
transport.crc: CRC16/MODBUS over bytes2..11, initial0xFFFF, little-endian bytes12..13

opening.handoff: original open-claw and SEARCH, then existing 140-degree inspection; wheel DONE is not proof of map-centre arrival

visual_align.arg_a: signed int16 big-endian pixels, subsection point minus640; positive requests body-right
visual_align.source_frame: existing uint32 big-endian bytes8..11 of 0x1D; existing frame-order handling, no age gate
visual_align.completion: original gyro alignment must finish first; lateral hysteresis must complete; a new large error clears old completed
visual_align.pause: existing PAUSE stops output and preserves action and lateral hysteresis; same valid ALIGN resumes

platform_reaudit.request: source frame0, zero classes/counts/total, non-STABLE, only the current injury-destination bit may be set
platform_reaudit.allowed_state: closed-claw TASK_ALIGN_SAFE_ZONE, moving or complete, before ENTER; formal current destination must match
platform_reaudit.target_state: existing TASK_TRANSPORT_AUDIT/mode48, camera140, original camera preparation and two-frame audit
platform_reaudit.repeat: same action does not restart the camera or sample timer
platform_reaudit.no_new_entry: arbitrary unfinished NAV, ENTER, open claw or released load
